meta.name: seo-local
meta.description: Local SEO analysis covering Google Business Profile optimization, NAP consistency, citation health, review signals, local schema markup, location page quality, multi-location SEO, and industry-specific recommendations. Detects business type (brick-and-mortar, SAB, hybrid) and industry vertical (restaurant, healthcare, legal, home services, real estate, automotive). Use when user says "local SEO", "Google Business Profile", "GBP", "map pack", "local pack", "citations", "NAP consistency", "local rankings", "service area", "multi-location", or "local search".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地搜索表现并优化商家信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要提升本地搜索排名和Google商家资料表现。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local search performance and optimize business listings.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to improve local search rankings and Google Business Profile performance.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析你的本地 SEO 状况，包括 Google 商家资料优化、NAP 一致性、评论信号、本地结构化数据、多门店 SEO 等，并生成一份详细的本地 SEO 报告。
howto.when: 当你提到“本地 SEO”、“Google 商家资料”、“GBP”、“地图包”、“本地包”、“引用”、“NAP 一致性”、“本地排名”、“服务区域”、“多门店”或“本地搜索”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 分析我的本地 SEO，网址是 example.com。
say.note: Claude 会生成一份完整的本地 SEO 分析报告。

say.text: 检查我的 Google 商家资料优化情况。
say.note: Claude 会重点分析 GBP 信号并给出优化建议。

say.text: 帮我看看 NAP 一致性有没有问题。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will analyze your local SEO, including Google Business Profile optimization, NAP consistency, review signals, local schema markup, multi-location SEO, and generate a detailed local SEO report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "local SEO", "Google Business Profile", "GBP", "map pack", "local pack", "citations", "NAP consistency", "local rankings", "service area", "multi-location", or "local search".

say_en.text: Analyze my local SEO for example.com.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a full local SEO analysis report.

say_en.text: Check my Google Business Profile optimization.
say_en.note: Claude will focus on GBP signals and provide optimization tips.
Claude will compare NAP across page, schema, and GBP.
